name: ucmr5-first-sample-pfas
description: For a U.S. public water system subject to UCMR 5, will its first entry-point sample contain PFOA or PFOS at or above the UCMR 5 minimum reporting level?
split_description: Fixed chronological split by the first sample's CollectionDate: train 2023-01-01 to 2023-11-30; eval 2024-01-01 to 2024-11-30; holdout 2025-01-01 to 2026-06-30. Exclude December 2023 and December 2024 as a 31-day embargo at each year boundary so late-period laboratory results are not realized after the next period starts. No random shuffling. Because there is one row per PWS, no panel history is used and no current-sample result enters features.
